title: revenue-equivalence-lean
summary: A Lean formalization of Myerson's 1981 revenue equivalence theorem in a single-parameter Bayesian mechanism-design model with continuous real types. The formal result is RevenueEquivalence.Palomar.revenueEquivalence (X P1 P2 : ℝ → ℝ) (h1 : BIC X P1) (h2 : BIC X P2) (hU : interimUtility X P1 0 = interimUtility X P2 0) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : P1 t = P2 t: two Bayesian incentive-compatible mechanisms with the same interim allocation rule and the same interim utility at the reference type (type zero) charge the same interim payments at every nonnegative type.
